## Purpose

Describe the concrete change and its phase/task IDs.

## Scope and artifacts

State what exists now, what is proposed and any optional scope decision.
Link actual documents/source; planned source paths are not implementation.

## Validation

Record exact commands, commit/environment/results and hosted run.
Separate documentation, application, scripted and physical evidence.

## Review and limitations

- [ ] Intended diff/output exclusions reviewed.
- [ ] Requirements/design/tasks match current behavior.
- [ ] Remaining evidence and optional decisions explicit.
- [ ] Owner review requested; no automatic merge or Classroom action.
